text_en: A Song. A Psalm of the Korahites. To the leader: according to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
text_cn: 科辣黑子孙的诗歌，交与乐官，悲调歌唱。则辣黑人赫曼的训诲诗。

text_en: O Lord , God of my salvation, when, at night, I cry out in your presence,
text_cn: 上主我天主，我白天祷告， 我黑夜在你的面前哀号。

text_en: let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry.
text_cn: 愿我的祈祷上达你前， 求你侧耳听我的呼喊。

text_en: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
text_cn: 因我的心灵饱受灾难， 我的性命已临近阴间；

text_en: I am counted among those who go down to the Pit; I am like those who have no help,
text_cn: 我已被列在进入坟墓的人中， 我已变成与无气力的人相同。

text_en: like those forsaken among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, like those whom you remember no more, for they are cut off from your hand.
text_cn: 我的床榻铺在死人的中间， 与葬于坟墓者的尸身作伴， 你已不再记念他们， 你已不再照顾他们。

text_en: You have put me in the depths of the Pit, in the regions dark and deep.
text_cn: 你把我放在极深的坑间， 你把我置于黑暗和深渊。

text_en: Your wrath lies heavy upon me, and you overwhelm me with all your waves. Selah
text_cn: 你的忿怒气焰重压着我， 你的大浪巨涛苦害着我。 （休止）

text_en: You have caused my companions to shun me; you have made me a thing of horror to them. I am shut in so that I cannot escape;
text_cn: 你叫我的知己弃我远去， 你使我被他们痛恨厌恶； 我受他们拘留不得外出。

text_en: my eye grows dim through sorrow. Every day I call on you, O Lord ; I spread out my hands to you.
text_cn: 我的眼睛因痛苦而憔悴， 上主，我天天在呼号着你， 也把我的双手向你举起。

text_en: Do you work wonders for the dead? Do the shades rise up to praise you? Selah
text_cn: 难道你还要给死人发显奇迹， 或者去世的人会起来称谢你？ （休止）

text_en: Is your steadfast love declared in the grave, or your faithfulness in Abaddon?
text_cn: 难道在坟墓里还有人称述你的仁慈， 或者在阴府内还有人宣扬你的信义？

text_en: Are your wonders known in the darkness, or your saving help in the land of forgetfulness?
text_cn: 难道在幽暗处能有人明了你的奇迹？ 或者在遗忘区还有人晓得你的正义？

text_en: But I, O Lord , cry out to you; in the morning my prayer comes before you.
text_cn: 但是上主，我现今呼号你， 我的祈祷早晨上达于你；

text_en: O Lord , why do you cast me off? Why do you hide your face from me?
text_cn: 上主，你为什么舍弃了我的灵魂？ 又为什么向我掩起了你的慈容？

text_en: Wretched and close to death from my youth up, I suffer your terrors; I am desperate.
text_cn: 我自幼受苦，几乎死去， 受你的威吓，万分恐惧；

text_en: Your wrath has swept over me; your dread assaults destroy me.
text_cn: 你的盛怒将我淹没， 你的威吓使我死掉，

text_en: They surround me like a flood all day long; from all sides they close in on me.
text_cn: 像水一样常环绕着我， 由四周齐来紧围着我。

text_en: You have caused friend and neighbor to shun me; my companions are in darkness.
text_cn: 你使亲友同伴将我离弃， 黑暗成了我的家人知己。
